input: Learn to identify local bird species by call

gold.taskTitle: Learn to identify local bird species by call
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to develop the skill of recognising local bird species by listening to their calls and songs.

questions.title: Which region or habitat do you live in?
questions.description: Understanding the user's geographic location and local environment to narrow down relevant bird species.

questions.title: How many species are you aiming to identify?
questions.description: Establishing a concrete target number of bird species the user wants to learn.

questions.title: What is your current level of birding experience?
questions.description: Gauging whether the user is a complete beginner or has some prior knowledge of birds or their calls.

questions.title: Do you prefer apps, books, or audio recordings to learn?
questions.description: Identifying the user's preferred learning format or resources for studying bird calls.

questions.title: By when do you want to reach this goal?
questions.description: Defining a deadline or timeframe to structure the learning plan appropriately.

questions.title: Will you practice indoors, outdoors, or both?
questions.description: Clarifying whether the user intends to learn through recordings at home, active fieldwork, or a mix of both.

questions.title: How much time per week can you dedicate to this?
questions.description: Understanding the user's available time commitment to set a realistic and manageable learning pace.
